SCRIPT.JAPANESE:
‐ 肌色のストッキング！
‐ 黒のストッキング！

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 세상 스타킹 다 사드려 봤었는데
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve bought just about every kind of stockings for Miss Gran—
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我可是几乎给她买遍了所有颜色的丝袜
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 所有絲襪我都買來給您試穿過了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、世の中のストッキングほとんど全部プレゼントしたんですけど、
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku udah pernah beliin hampir semua jenis stoking buat Miss Gran—
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu já comprei todos os tipos que existem,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Yo le he comprado todos los tipos que existen,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من تقریباً همه نوع جوراب برای خانم گرن خریده ام-

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그란님 최애는 무조건 검은색 스타킹입니다! 검스!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: but her all-time favorite is definitely black. Always black!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 圆圆的最爱绝对是黑色丝袜！黑丝！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 圓圓最愛的絕對是黑色絲襪！黑絲！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: グランさんの一番のお気に入りは間違いなく黒ストです！黒スト！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: tapi yang paling dia suka dari dulu tuh jelas stoking hitam. Selalu hitam!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: mas as favoritas dela são as pretas! Ela usa o tempo todo!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: pero sus favoritas son las negras! ¡Siempre las usa!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما مورد علاقه همیشه او قطعا سیاه است. همیشه سیاه!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 기억하네? 내가 이래서 유만 씨를 좋아해.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You remembered? See, this is why I like you, Yuman.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这都记得？所以说嘛，我就喜欢你这点~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你都還記得啊？我就是因為喜歡你這點～
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 覚えてたの？ こうだから私、ユマンさんのこと好きなんだよね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu inget? Nih, makanya aku suka kamu, Yuman.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você lembra disso? Por isso eu gosto de você, Yumán.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Lo recuerdas? Por eso me caes bien, Yumán.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یادت افتاد؟ ببین، به همین دلیل است که من تو را دوست دارم، یومان.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’re sneakily good at remembering things about me~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 对关于我的事记忆力都特别好~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 對於我的事情記憶力都特別好
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私のこと、意外とよく覚えてるじゃん〜
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu diam-diam jago banget inget hal-hal tentang aku~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você lembra até dos pequenos detalhes sobre mim~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Recuerdas hasta los poqueños detalles sobre mí~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تو در به خاطر سپردن چیزهای مربوط به من خیلی خوب هستی~

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Just keep teaching me, and I’ll remember everything!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 以后也多多告诉我关于你的事吧！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 以後也請繼續告訴關於您的事吧！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これからもどんどん教えてください！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu terus ajarin aku aja, nanti aku inget semuanya!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فقط به من یاد بده، و من همه چیز را به خاطر خواهم آورد!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 僕、全部覚えておきますから！
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: و من همه چیز را به یاد خواهم آورد!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Chief, you’ve got a guest here.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 課長、お客様が来られました
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh iya—mereka bilang mau datang hari ini.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh right—they said they were coming today.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、そうだ 来る予定だった
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, é verdade, ela vinha hoje.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه درست - اونا گفتند امروز می آیند.
